text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"Dear Mom and Dad, Hishi Ama-san, who I'm 
running with in today's race (she's the 
Miho Dorm head!), was so totally 
dignified..."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"She really is a cool 'City Girl'! ...Come 
to think of it, I've seen a whole bunch of 
'City Girls' up until now."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"That made me realize. A 'City Girl' 
shines as bright as the hard work and 
struggles she puts in. ...Then I should be 
able to become one too!"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
"It's almost post time for the race. I'll 
leave this letter with Trainer-san and 
write the rest after the race is over."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin's Letter
text_block_list.text:
“I'll shine brighter than anyone else 
running today, and become the true ‘City 
Girl’ I've always dreamed of! ...Here I 
go!”
